items.title: Jameson Lopp — Bitcoin security resources (lopp.net)
items.what: A career security engineer's curated hub of self-custody and OpSec guides, threat models, and tool comparisons — the single best jumping-off point for going deeper.

items.title: Blockchain Commons — SmartCustody
items.what: A free, open guide (and book) that walks you through modeling the real risks to your keys and building a resilient backup and recovery plan.

items.title: Bitcoiner Guide (BitcoinQnA)
items.what: Plain-language, vendor-neutral how-to guides and a large privacy/self-custody Q&A covering wallets, backups, and passphrases.

items.title: BTC Sessions (YouTube)
items.what: Clear, step-by-step video tutorials for setting up hardware wallets and doing your first self-custody transactions — great for watch-along beginners.

items.title: WalletScrutiny
items.what: Independently checks whether a wallet app is actually open-source and reproducible, so you can tell verifiable software from "trust us" claims.

items.title: WalletsRecovery.org
items.what: Documents each wallet's backup format and derivation paths so you can restore your coins in a different wallet if a vendor disappears.

items.title: Lopp's metal seed-storage stress tests
items.what: Hard data from fire-, crush-, and acid-testing metal backup plates. This is the source behind our own metal-backup page — go here for the full per-device results.

items.title: Coldcard documentation
items.what: Thorough docs for a Bitcoin-only hardware wallet, covering air-gapped signing, passphrases, and multisig for anyone hardening their setup.

items.title: SeedSigner
items.what: Docs for a DIY, stateless, air-gapped signer you build from cheap parts — a hands-on way to learn how signing devices actually work.

items.title: Mastering Bitcoin (Andreas Antonopoulos) — keys & wallets chapters
items.what: The free, canonical technical reference; its keys, addresses, and wallets chapters explain what your seed phrase and private keys really are.

items.title: Citadel Dispatch (Matt Odell)
items.what: An interview podcast focused on Bitcoin privacy, self-custody, and running your own node — practitioner conversations on staying sovereign.
